```{r, library import, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(readxl)
```


```{r, raw data import, echo = FALSE, warning =FALSE}
adair_roots <- read_excel('PROP_ADAIR/root_crown_data/prop_adair_root_measurement.xlsx', na = 'NA')
adair_crown <- read_excel('PROP_ADAIR/root_crown_data/prop_adair_root_system_measurement.xlsx', na = 'NA')

picos_roots <- read_excel('PROP_PICOS/root_crown_data/prop_picos_root_measurement.xlsx', na = 'NA')
picos_crown <- read_excel('PROP_PICOS/root_crown_data/prop_picos_root_system_measurement.xlsx', na = 'NA')
```

```{r, raw data cleaning and preprocessing, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
picos_roots$n_branch_seg <- str_remove(picos_roots$n_branch_seg, ' ')
picos_roots$n_branch_seg <- str_replace(picos_roots$n_branch_seg, '\\(<', '\\(all<')

picos_roots <- picos_roots %>% 
        mutate(extra = sys_id) %>% 
        separate(extra, into = c('row', 'tree')) %>% 
        mutate(row = str_pad(row, width =2, side = 'left', pad = '0'), # pad row
               tree = str_pad(tree, width = 2, side = 'left', pad = '0'), # pad tree
               n_branch = as.numeric(as.vector(str_match(picos_roots$n_branch_seg, pattern = '^(\\d+)\\(*')[,2])),# capture first number
               branch_sub5mm = as.vector(str_match(picos_roots$n_branch_seg, pattern = '(\\d+)<')[,2]), # capture second number
               all_branch_sub5mm = as.vector(str_match(picos_roots$n_branch_seg, 'all')),
               n_br_lt5mm = as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(picos_roots$all_branch_sub5mm) == TRUE, picos_roots$branch_sub5mm)))





```
